stem: Find the range of values of the constant $k$ for which the quadratic equation $x^2-(k+{=p})x+{=q}=0$ has two distinct imaginary solutions. Give your answer as an interval for $k$.
notes:
Advanced: D is a perfect-square-difference in (k+p); solving D<0 gives a bounded open interval. Bounds are integers; strict inequality since distinct imaginary needs D<0.
